audio: Look! There is a big ship on the river.
q: What did you hear?
explain: Ship (navio) tem 'i' curto; sheep (ovelha) tem 'i' longo, como um 'iii' esticado.

audio: My name is Laura and I am twelve years old.
q: How old is Laura?
explain: Twelve = 12; twenty = 20. Preste atenção no final: -elve x -enty.

audio: The cat is under the table.
q: Where is the cat?
explain: Under = embaixo de. On = em cima; behind = atrás; next to = ao lado.

audio: Can I have a pen, please? I want to write my name.
q: What does the speaker want?
explain: Pen (caneta) soa com 'é'; pan (panela) tem 'a' bem aberto; pin (alfinete) tem 'i'.

audio: It is three o'clock.
q: What time is it?
explain: Three o'clock = três horas em ponto; o'clock indica hora exata.

audio: My brother likes green apples.
q: What color are the apples?
explain: Green = verde. Cuidado: grey (cinza) começa com som parecido.

audio: I live in a small house.
q: Which word did you hear?
explain: Live (morar) tem 'i' curto; leave (sair, partir) tem 'i' longo.

audio: Open your books to page ten.
q: Which page does the teacher say?
explain: Ten = 10. Não confunda com two (2) e twelve (12).

audio: We go to the beach on Sunday.
q: When do they go to the beach?
explain: Sunday = domingo; Saturday = sábado. Dias da semana em inglês levam letra maiúscula.

audio: She has a black bag.
q: What does she have?
explain: Bag (bolsa) tem 'a' bem aberto; bug (inseto) soa perto de 'bâg'.

audio: There are four chairs in the kitchen.
q: How many chairs are there?
explain: Four = 4; fourteen = 14; forty = 40. Preste atenção na sílaba final.

audio: I am hungry.
q: How does the speaker feel?
explain: Hungry = com fome. Angry (bravo) soa parecido, mas não tem o 'h' inicial.

audio: My father is a doctor.
q: What is the father's job?
explain: Doctor = médico. Dentist = dentista; driver = motorista.

audio: Turn left at the park.
q: Which way should you turn?
explain: Left = esquerda; right = direita. Turn left = vire à esquerda.

audio: I drink milk every morning.
q: What does the speaker drink?
explain: Milk = leite. Every morning = toda manhã.

audio: This is my dog, Max.
q: What is Max?
explain: Dog = cachorro; duck = pato, que tem som parecido.

audio: The shop opens at nine.
q: When does the shop open?
explain: Nine = 9. Night (noite) começa igual a nine, mas termina com som de 't'.

audio: Look at that big hat on his head!
q: Which word did you hear?
explain: Hat (chapéu) tem 'a' aberto; hot (quente) soa como 'ó'; hit (bater) tem 'i'.

audio: Good night, see you tomorrow.
q: When will they meet again?
explain: Tomorrow = amanhã. Tonight = hoje à noite.

audio: My sister has long brown hair.
q: What is the sister's hair like?
explain: Long = comprido; brown = castanho. O adjetivo vem antes do substantivo: long brown hair.

audio: The train to London leaves at seven thirty from platform four.
q: What time does the train leave?
explain: Seven thirty = 7:30. Thirty tem acento no início; thirteen (13), no final.

audio: A ticket for the museum costs fifteen dollars, but students pay only eight.
q: How much do students pay?
explain: Students pay only eight = estudantes pagam só 8. Fifteen (15) é o preço normal.

audio: I'm sorry, I can't come to your party on Saturday. I have to visit my grandmother.
q: Why can't the speaker go to the party?
explain: Have to visit my grandmother = preciso visitar minha avó: um compromisso de família.

audio: Can you buy some bread, six eggs and a bottle of water on your way home?
q: How many eggs does the speaker need?
explain: Six = 6; sixteen = 16. Ouça o final -teen para diferenciar.

audio: My phone number is nine eight seven, five five two, four one zero.
q: What is the phone number?
explain: Telefones são ditos dígito por dígito, em blocos; o zero às vezes é dito 'oh'.

audio: Hello, this is Anna. I'm calling about the flat. Is it still available?
q: Why is Anna calling?
explain: Flat é o termo britânico para apartment (apartamento). Available = disponível.

audio: The weather will be cold and rainy in the morning, but sunny in the afternoon.
q: What will the weather be like in the afternoon?
explain: In the afternoon = à tarde. Frio e chuva são só de manhã (in the morning).

audio: Excuse me, the bank is on the corner, opposite the supermarket.
q: Where is the bank?
explain: Opposite = em frente, do outro lado da rua; é o mesmo que across from.

audio: I usually get up at six, but on weekends I sleep until ten.
q: When does the speaker get up on weekends?
explain: On weekends = nos fins de semana; sleep until ten = dormir até as dez.

audio: We're sorry, flight two four five to Miami is delayed by forty minutes.
q: What is the problem with the flight?
explain: Delayed = atrasado. Forty (40) tem acento no início; fourteen (14), no final.

audio: The weather is nice, so I want to walk to work today.
q: How will the speaker go to work?
explain: Walk (caminhar) soa como 'wók', sem o L; work (trabalho) soa como 'wârk'.

audio: The library closes at eight in the evening.
q: When does the library close?
explain: In the evening = à noite; logo, eight in the evening = 20h (8 p.m.).

audio: I'd like a large orange juice and a cheese sandwich, please.
q: What does the customer order?
options: Apple juice and a cheese sandwich
Orange juice and a ham sandwich
Orange juice and a cheese sandwich
explain: I'd like = eu gostaria; é a forma educada de pedir algo num café ou restaurante.

audio: The English course starts on the third of May.
q: When does the course start?
explain: The third of May = 3 de maio. Datas usam ordinais: third = terceiro.

audio: Sorry I'm late. I missed the bus, so I took a taxi.
q: How did the speaker arrive?
explain: Missed the bus = perdeu o ônibus; took a taxi = pegou um táxi.

audio: My cousin is a nurse. She works at night in a big hospital.
q: When does the cousin work?
explain: Works at night = trabalha à noite. Nurse = enfermeira.

audio: The shoes were sixty dollars, but today they are on sale for forty.
q: How much are the shoes today?
explain: On sale = em promoção. Hoje custam forty (40), não sixty (60).

audio: Did you see the full moon last night?
q: Which word did you hear?
explain: Full (cheio) tem 'u' curto; fool (bobo) tem 'u' longo; fall (cair) soa como 'fól'.

audio: Take the lift to the fifth floor. My office is the second door on the right.
q: Where is the office?
explain: Lift (britânico) = elevator. Fifth floor = 5º andar; on the right = à direita.

audio: I'm really tired because I studied until two in the morning.
q: Why is the speaker tired?
explain: Studied until two in the morning = estudou até as duas da manhã.

audio: Attention, please. The store will close in fifteen minutes. Please take your items to the checkout.
q: What should customers do?
explain: Checkout = caixa. In fifteen minutes = daqui a 15 minutos, não 50.

audio: I was going to take the bus, but it started raining, so my dad gave me a ride.
q: How did the speaker travel?
explain: Give someone a ride = dar carona. O plano do ônibus mudou por causa da chuva.

audio: The meeting was supposed to start at ten, but it has been moved to eleven fifteen.
q: What time does the meeting start now?
explain: Has been moved to = foi remarcada para. Fifteen (15) é diferente de fifty (50).

audio: If you order before midnight, delivery is free. After that, it costs five ninety-nine.
q: How can you get free delivery?
options: Pick it up at the store
explain: Before midnight = antes da meia-noite; depois disso, a entrega custa 5,99.

audio: Honestly, the movie was too long, but the music was amazing.
q: What did the speaker like about the movie?
explain: Too long é uma crítica; amazing (incrível) é o elogio, e vai para a música.

audio: Could you speak up a little? I can't hear you very well.
q: What does the speaker want?
explain: Speak up = falar mais alto. Não confunda com shut up (calar a boca).

audio: The doctor said I need to rest for three days and drink lots of water.
q: How long should the speaker rest?
explain: Rest for three days = descansar por três dias; for indica duração.

audio: We ran out of milk, so I made black coffee instead.
q: Why did the speaker make black coffee?
explain: Run out of = acabar (o estoque de algo). Instead = em vez disso.

audio: Hi, it's Bruno. I'm stuck in traffic, so start the presentation without me. I'll be there in twenty minutes.
q: What does Bruno ask his colleagues to do?
explain: Stuck in traffic = preso no trânsito; ele pede que comecem sem ele (without me).

audio: The gym is open from six in the morning to ten at night, except on Sundays, when it closes at two in the afternoon.
q: When does the gym close on Sundays?
explain: Except on Sundays = exceto aos domingos, quando fecha às duas da tarde.

audio: I've been learning the guitar for about three years, and I practice every evening.
q: How long has the speaker been learning the guitar?
explain: Have been learning for = vem aprendendo há; for indica quanto tempo dura a ação.

audio: Our hotel room had a beautiful view of the sea, but the bed was really uncomfortable.
q: What was the problem with the hotel?
explain: Uncomfortable = desconfortável. A vista (view of the sea) foi elogiada.

audio: Please don't forget to bring your passport and a copy of your ticket to the airport.
q: What must you take to the airport?
options: Your passport and a ticket copy
explain: Don't forget to bring = não esqueça de levar: passaporte e uma cópia da passagem.

audio: My sister is two years older than me. I'm fifteen, so she's seventeen.
q: How old is the speaker?
explain: I'm fifteen = tenho 15 anos. A irmã, dois anos mais velha (older), tem 17.

audio: The museum is free on Wednesdays, but you need to book your visit online first.
q: What do you need to do before a free visit?
explain: Book = reservar. Free on Wednesdays = grátis às quartas, com reserva online.

audio: I'm not sure about the red jacket. Can I try it in a smaller size?
q: What does the customer want?
explain: Try it in a smaller size = experimentar num tamanho menor.

audio: Turn off the oven after forty-five minutes, and let the cake cool down before you cut it.
q: What should you do before cutting the cake?
explain: Cool down = esfriar. Before you cut it = antes de cortar.

audio: Sorry, the number you are calling is not available. Please try again later.
q: Where would you hear this?
explain: The number you are calling = o número para o qual você liga: é uma mensagem telefônica.

audio: Take this road for two kilometers, then turn right at the gas station. The school is just after the bridge.
q: Where is the school?
explain: Just after the bridge = logo depois da ponte. Gas station = posto de gasolina.

audio: I'd love to join you for lunch, but I've already eaten. Maybe a coffee later?
q: What does the speaker suggest?
explain: I've already eaten = já comi. Maybe a coffee later? = que tal um café mais tarde?

audio: Oh great, another meeting that could have been an email. Just what I needed today.
q: How does the speaker feel about the meeting?
explain: O tom é sarcástico: 'Oh great' e 'just what I needed' expressam irritação.

audio: I wouldn't say no to another slice of that pie, if there's any left.
q: What does the speaker mean?
explain: I wouldn't say no to = eu aceitaria; é um jeito educado de pedir algo.

audio: You might want to double-check those numbers before you send the report to the director.
q: What is the speaker doing?
explain: You might want to... é uma sugestão educada; indica que pode haver erros nos números.

audio: I've been meaning to call you for weeks, but things have been crazy at work.
q: What is the speaker doing?
explain: I've been meaning to = eu estava querendo (mas não fiz); é um pedido de desculpas.

audio: Well, the food was fine, I suppose, but I'm not sure I'd go back.
q: What is the speaker's opinion of the restaurant?
explain: 'Fine, I suppose' e 'not sure I'd go back' mostram uma opinião morna, sem entusiasmo.

audio: If I'd known the traffic would be this bad, I'd have taken the metro.
q: What can we infer?
options: The speaker didn't take the metro.
explain: Third conditional (If I'd known... I'd have taken) fala de algo que NÃO aconteceu.

audio: Sure, I can cover your shift on Friday, as long as you take mine next Tuesday.
q: What does the speaker agree to do?
options: Work Friday if the other person works Tuesday
explain: As long as = desde que. É uma troca: cobre a sexta se o outro cobrir a terça.

audio: Honestly, I couldn't care less who wins the game tonight.
q: How does the speaker feel about the game?
explain: Couldn't care less = não estou nem aí; expressa total falta de interesse.

audio: Next stop, Central Station. Change here for the airport line. Please mind the gap.
q: Why should airport passengers get off at Central Station?
explain: Change here for = faça a baldeação aqui para. Mind the gap = cuidado com o vão.

audio: I'm not saying your idea is bad. It's just that we tried something similar last year, and it didn't really take off.
q: What does the speaker think of the idea?
explain: Take off = decolar, fazer sucesso. A fala sugere, com tato, que a ideia pode não dar certo.

audio: Mariana was supposed to be here an hour ago. It's not like her to be late.
q: What does the speaker suggest about Mariana?
explain: It's not like her = não é típico dela; ou seja, ela normalmente é pontual.

audio: Could you keep it down a bit? Some of us are trying to study in here.
q: What does the speaker want?
explain: Keep it down = fazer menos barulho. O tom mostra uma leve irritação.

audio: The flight was delayed, the hotel lost our booking, and then it rained all week. Still, we had a laugh.
q: What was the speaker's overall experience?
explain: Still = mesmo assim; had a laugh = se divertiu. Apesar dos problemas, foi divertido.

audio: I'd rather you didn't post that photo of me online, if you don't mind.
q: What is the speaker asking?
explain: I'd rather you didn't = eu preferiria que você não fizesse; é um pedido educado.

audio: If Pedro says it'll be ready on Monday, I'd plan for Thursday at the earliest.
q: What does the speaker think about Pedro?
explain: At the earliest = na melhor das hipóteses; ou seja, Pedro costuma atrasar.

audio: You'll never guess who I bumped into at the mall today. Our old English teacher!
q: How did the speaker meet the teacher?
explain: Bump into = encontrar alguém por acaso, sem ter combinado.

audio: The new app is great, don't get me wrong. I just wish it didn't drain my battery so fast.
q: What is the speaker's complaint?
options: The app uses a lot of battery.
The app is hard to use.
explain: Drain the battery = descarregar a bateria. 'Don't get me wrong' suaviza a crítica.

audio: Tickets for Saturday's concert sold out in ten minutes, so we'll have to settle for the Sunday show.
q: What will the speakers probably do?
explain: Settle for = contentar-se com uma segunda opção; sold out = esgotado.

audio: Look, I know you're busy, but this really can't wait until tomorrow.
q: What is the speaker expressing?
explain: Can't wait until tomorrow = não pode esperar até amanhã; indica urgência.

audio: I'm sure Lucas meant well, but his comment came across as a bit rude.
q: What does the speaker think about Lucas?
options: He meant well but sounded rude.
explain: Mean well = ter boa intenção; come across as = soar como, passar a impressão de.

audio: Frankly, calling the project a success would be stretching it. We hit our targets, but only after cutting half the features.
q: What is the speaker's view of the project?
explain: Stretching it = exagerar. Ele admite as metas batidas, mas com ressalvas sérias.

audio: I'm not one to gossip, but let's just say Daniel's promotion raised a few eyebrows in the office.
q: What does the speaker imply?
options: People found it surprising or suspicious.
explain: Raise eyebrows = causar surpresa ou desconfiança.

audio: Had we known about the strike earlier, we could have rebooked everyone on the morning flight.
q: What happened?
options: They learned about the strike too late.
explain: Had we known = If we had known; a inversão indica algo que não aconteceu.

audio: The report makes some valid points, although I'd take its conclusions with a pinch of salt, given who paid for it.
q: Why is the speaker cautious about the report?
options: Its funder may have biased it.
explain: With a pinch of salt = com desconfiança; given who paid for it sugere possível viés.

audio: Needless to say, the new manager's first speech didn't exactly win the team over.
q: How did the team react to the speech?
explain: Didn't exactly = não foi bem assim (eufemismo); win over = conquistar.

audio: It's not that I object to working late now and then. What bothers me is being expected to, without so much as a thank you.
q: What is the speaker's main complaint?
options: Having to work late at all
explain: Without so much as = sem nem mesmo. O incômodo é a falta de reconhecimento.

audio: By the time we reach the summit, the sun will have set, so we'd better turn back now.
q: Why does the speaker suggest turning back?
options: It will be dark before they reach the top.
explain: Will have set = terá se posto (future perfect): vai escurecer antes de chegarem ao topo.

audio: With all due respect, I think you're missing the point. Nobody is questioning the budget. The issue is the timeline.
q: What does the speaker want to clarify?
options: The real problem is the schedule.
They want to cancel the plan.
explain: Missing the point = não entender o essencial. Timeline = cronograma, prazo.

audio: Rather than waiting for the perfect moment, Camila decided to launch the product and fix any issues along the way.
q: What does this say about Camila's approach?
options: She prefers to act and adjust later.
explain: Along the way = ao longo do caminho. Ela prefere agir já e ajustar depois.

audio: I'd hardly call it a bargain. Once you add delivery and installation, it costs more than the one in the shop.
q: What does the speaker think about the offer?
explain: Hardly = dificilmente; I'd hardly call it a bargain = não é pechincha nenhuma.

audio: Well, that went about as well as could be expected, all things considered.
q: What does the speaker mean?
options: It was far better than expected.
It was OK, given the circumstances.
explain: As well as could be expected = tão bem quanto dava; all things considered = considerando tudo.

audio: Much as I admire her talent, I can't overlook the fact that she missed three deadlines in a row.
q: What is the speaker's attitude towards her?
explain: Much as = por mais que (concessão). Overlook = ignorar, deixar passar.

audio: I'll grant you that the plan is ambitious, but ambitious and unrealistic aren't the same thing.
q: What is the speaker arguing about the plan?
options: That it is ambitious but achievable
explain: I'll grant you = admito que. Ele concede o ponto, mas diz que ambicioso não é irrealista.

audio: You've caught me at a bit of a bad time, I'm afraid. Mind if I get back to you once things calm down?
q: What does the speaker want to do?
explain: Caught me at a bad time = me pegou numa hora ruim; get back to you = retornar o contato.

audio: Not only did the new policy fail to cut costs, it actually drove some of our best people away.
q: What was the result of the policy?
options: It saved money but lost staff.
It saved money and kept staff.
It didn't save money and lost good staff.
explain: Not only... soma dois problemas; drive away = afastar, fazer alguém ir embora.

audio: Between you and me, the interview could have gone better. I kept rambling whenever they asked about my weaknesses.
q: What went wrong in the interview?
options: The speaker talked too much without focus.
explain: Ramble = falar sem parar e sem foco. Between you and me = cá entre nós.

audio: Of course, I'd be delighted to spend my entire weekend redoing a report nobody will read.
q: What is the speaker's real attitude?
explain: O exagero (delighted, entire weekend, nobody will read) revela sarcasmo e insatisfação.

audio: The figures speak for themselves. Sales have plateaued, and unless we rethink our strategy, we risk falling behind.
q: What is the speaker's main message?
options: Change is needed to stay competitive.
explain: Plateau = estabilizar, parar de crescer. Unless we rethink = a não ser que repensemos.

audio: I was all set to accept the offer, but the more I read the contract, the less convinced I became.
q: How did the speaker's feelings change?
explain: All set to = pronto para. The more..., the less... = quanto mais..., menos...: a dúvida cresceu.

audio: It goes without saying that the event wouldn't have happened without the volunteers, who gave up their weekends to make it work.
q: What is the speaker doing?
explain: It goes without saying = nem é preciso dizer; gave up their weekends = abriram mão dos fins de semana.
